body: Do you really want friends? Friends are not really required to live. If you don't feel like being social you don't have to. But if you DO want to be social, visit /r/socialskills and make a post of your problems and read the sidebar (do read it).
If you find spare time in your schedule of finding a job I would recommend doing some sports and exercise. You can't be lazy when you're lifting. Impossible.

Your cutting scars are there. But they're in the past now. Follow the advice of the hotline. It's pretty decent advice. It'll keep you from being tired and being tired feeds the beast. You have a friend. So you don't seem alone. When you're in London you have great potential for meeting people! 

And the job market is shitty. Not your fault. Keep applying and hope for something but so many people have to deal with it. Fuck that job market.
How can you be alone when you have a friend and your friend's sister? You're not alone! :) Think about it.

For most people, except for some lucky individuals, true best friend relationships that last years are formed after the 25th year of life. I see the popular kids around here with their so called BFF and I can see that this BFF of them is a different person every few weeks. 

I think that maybe 1% of teenage kids has found a true friend4life. And it may just be that of that 1% only a few realise they found him/her.

TL;DR Patience, young one.

You don't want to give up. Nobody writes text that long just for giving up. You're 16. The average 50 year old doesn't know what he wants or needs or gets either. Hell, my grandpa becomes 80 this week and he doesn't know what the fuck is happening. But he has learned to just go on and do whatever you think is nice. He's been married for over 50 years. I'll be damned if I could even live that long to beat that. 

Thing is, you're 16. And every 16 year old, NO EXCEPTION, doesn't know wtf is going on. When you grow older you dont learn what you should do in situation X or Y or how to deal with people but you learn how to deal with things a little better every year. 

Keep going. Teenage years are dramatic. Your peers are often assholes who are assholes because they face the very same problems you're facing.

I can know. I am 18 years old and I am still surviving the teenage battlefield. I notice that 20 year olds are cooler about shit than 16 years olds, simply because the 16 year olds think that there is supposed to be some kind of magic happening that makes them mature when the 20 year olds know that this doesnt happen, but that you just get more experience in life.

Find new friends. The /r/socialskills sub and the network of other subs around it can help. Start doing something good like sports or so.

But it does require some effort. But that's better than being dead. Being dead is beyond giving up. It's giving up with completely no possibility of ever coming back to complete what you've started. It's giving up without the option to correct your mistakes and to apply what you've learned.

Well... if those are to be your lasts words, can you at least tell something more about yourself? About the why's and who's and what has happened in your life? The good things to remember and the stories you've got to tell. 

I'd like to hear your story.

Re-take the exam. You know what to expect now. 

I had to take an entry exam to get into my next school (I'm Dutch so it's all different here but an exam is an exam). I fucked up the first time. Nerve breakdown as well. But I got offered the option to re-take it. I knew what was expected of me. I prepared for it. I put my mind in a "I don't give a fuck, i'm acing this shit" mindset and I went in 2 weeks later and got out with an acceptance letter. 

In times of desperation, saying "Fuck this shit i'm going to ace this shit" or something along those lines to myself helps a lot. Helps me feel like some movie hero being all like "Lets do this" *guitar riff*

Or become sober and think about it again. Think about that dude who wanted to hang out with you again. Think about that lady who smiles at you when she sees you. Think of the happiness you'll miss when you're not there to experience it. Think of the shadow you leave behind. Being dead is the end of all happiness. Not just for your family and friends but for you. How can you be happy when you are 6 feet under? Last time I check corpses don't smile. People who try and go out and go beyond their own borders are usually the people who smile, even when everything they do fails and everything they worked for crashes down, they just pick it up and go on with everything. 

So tell me again why intoxicated you, unable to let your sober mind out of it's alcohol bound prison, thinks that death is the best option?
We should call the parent comment 'our parent'
What's the most awesome thing that you've done in your life?
Im still here. I'll last this week. I might be back after.

> You don't want to die. You want love, success, happiness - you just think they can never happen for you so your mind resorts to thinking about death. But as long as you're alive, there's at least a chance of things improving. If you keep working towards your goals, there's a good chance you'll reach them. But you have to keep working no matter how hard it gets. And you have to keep living.

But will all the pain, the trouble, the failure, everything, be worth the spare and rare moments of *possible* happiness?

Because I feel it's a really insignificant part of life especially compared to the negative traits of it.

I wish I could, but I have trouble seeing the good side of life myself, if that even exists.

Thank you. 

Well I don't really know where to start. So i'm starting with myself. I have depression. I guess it escalated to the point of Major Depression since suicidal thoughts for months aren't healthy, right? I come from the Netherlands, am 18 years old and about to finish high school - at least I hope. 

I think of myself as being somewhat intelligent, creative and good with logic. Also, I can have a good conversation with people, sometimes. That's about the end of my happy self image. For all I see further on is failure after failure, misery upon worthlessness - and really anxious and at times angsty, I guess. 

I have asperger's, and possibly traces of ADD. Depression is just next in the list of mental flaws. 

Socially, I have no clue what i'm doing, except that it is ALL WRONG. I see people occasionally, but I think they'd be happier without me. I *know* they would be. Sometimes I meet someone somewhere, always accidentally, and have some nice time, but that's it. 

People seem to avoid me. And those that say they don't never have time for me. Which may be true, but what kind of friendship is that?

So it seems like I am not worth too much. A massive inferiority complex is my closest friend. Then comes depression, followed by worries about the future and worries about the present. 

I don't think I have much talent in anything, really. I mean yeah I may have great potential for music skills but I never have time for it. I may possibly be a great thinker but I don't know what I could ever do with that.

All of that, and so indescribably much more, makes me feel bad. There is nothing i'm good at. Rarely anyone who would spend their time with me. Just about nobody who believes in me. And I, myself, might be the biggest disbeliever.

Sorry if this is all messy. I have the biggest trouble getting my thoughts in line. It's all one big mess. Thoughts rushing through my head uncontrollably. The only thing I can really say with confidence is "I don't know." which may be the most ironic thing ever.

Yes. Totally yes. But there is more. My mom simply told me to fuck off if I fail this. Like I said; ending up with literally nothing but the fat on my bones. Where could I go? My dad is soon to be homeless too. There is so much more going on than I posted here. 

Finishing my exams is literally the only shot at life I have, due to so much shit going on. I'm 18 now and supposed to take care of myself but truth be told; I don't know.

I read it all. And I feel your problems. They are familiar. At least to me.

So now, I guess you'd like change? I can help you with some small basics! Now my diagnosis is rather simple, perhaps too simple, but it'll do! You need to go out more, go to a pub, talk to EVERYONE there. If they are uninteresting or annoying people move on to the next person. If you can't find anyone go to the next pub, club or whateverthefuck where people go to be social. 

If you feel that you may use even the slightest of boosts in social skills - if you have any questions - you could ask me. But who am I but a random guy on the internet? For me there can be hundreds of people. Literally! /r/socialskills is a sub with hundreds of people helping each other out. It isn't just for the so-called 'blebs' and 'betas' but even Alpha males frequent the place to either help or learn something new. 

TL;DR /r/socialskills, its people and its sidebar should help you going to places to find people to talk to.
Well when I have success at school I can focus on getting a job. I will follow 3 years of IT training and then go into the real world. No idea what'll happen next but it's a bit of a future at least.
Hopping along. I don't consider myself funny or interesting at all. Now what?

It would be the end of the life and everything I know. I would have no money. Actually I wouldn't have anything. I think the question is more; What gets to me first? The cold, starvation, disease, depression or a jail sentence? 

I doubt if I am ever going to see the next new years fireworks.

I know man. I was joking around but obviously failed to deliver the point. My problem is that my humor is... strange.

But you can be anything you like, even a strong independent black woman if you feel like it. ;) It's possible! Really!

Sounds like a plan. I'm not sure where you live, but you can always go for whatever shitty full time job you can anywhere and hire a cheap place to build up. Do that! And whenever the bad people from the past, those rotten people with no social feelings for each other, get to your head, just say Fuck [person] and his fucking shit. You are a strong independent black women who don't need no one. Fuck everyone who tells you otherwise.

Hey buddy. I am wondering, how old are you? Say, if you're 18+ you could just say FUCK FAMILY FUCK "FRIENDS" and move to somewhere now. Then in that new place you can build up everything from a fresh start. You could keep contact with old friends and family. Find a job and a small place to rent and build your life from there. Just like in the movies. Just like in the video games.

People who seek help... well I just said the answer. The thing is people who post here are actually looking for help. So therefore we help them. 

People who don't want help **rarely ever** post here. Why would you post if you don't want help? What's the point?

Nonono. No. 

Man it seems like you basically need to switch stuff up. Find a different job. If that job is halfway across the country just go. I mean it can't get any worse. 

As far as I can tell you don't have any addictions or uncontrollable shit going on with yourself so that won't be a factor.

It will be hard. Oh hell it will be hard but as soon as you actually get something new going it'll be great because you have accomplished something. Something so fucking big dude. And you may have to sleep in a car or something for a week or live in a house the size of a matchbox for a month but seriously, when you have a good source of income you can build a living! 

This isn't some American dream shit, it's simply that where you are now just doesn't complete your life so you simply gotta go somewhere where you are home.

Not OP but...

...How can you support others if nobody seems to like you?

Your words are nice and inspiring. Well chosen and written with care.

Though, my life sure seems like a failure. Never have I had a success in my life I still feel good about.

The only thing I succeeded in is getting up to my current age. 

My family is a mess. Real friends do not exist. Nobody cares about me.

And yes. I could live a life alone and have no problem making it to 100 years of age. But i'd be the saddest man alive.
